checkName: Vulnerability, Support Needs and Foreseeable Harm Overlay
appliesTo: All cases as an overlay; enhanced where vulnerability is present

queries.text: client vulnerability assessment characteristics of vulnerability recorded
health condition bereavement life event low resilience or difficulty understanding
queries.note: Probes the four FG21/1 drivers directly, because a case with no vulnerability section may still hold indicators in the fact find or file notes.

triggerProbe.presentWhen: Any vulnerability characteristic or driver is recorded anywhere in the case.
triggerProbe.absentWhen: No characteristic and no assessment appears anywhere.
triggerProbe.note: This check is an overlay and always runs. Where nothing is found, the finding is about whether vulnerability was ever considered — not automatically N/A.

queryGroups.requirement: Details of additional support and needs, including third-party support

queries.text: additional support needs identified for this client and how they were met
family member attorney or third party attending the meeting on behalf of the client
power of attorney registered authority to act consent to share information
client requested that a relative be involved in the advice process

falsePositiveGuards: A recommendation to put a power of attorney in place is future planning, not evidence of current third-party support — distinguish the two.
A spouse present at a meeting is not automatically third-party support for a vulnerability.

sufficiency.ifAssertionAbsent: Where the file records support needs the report never mentions, that gap is the finding.
sufficiency.ifEvidenceAbsent: Where the report claims support arrangements with nothing in the file, treat the claim as unsupported.

queries.text: preferred method of communication email post telephone large print
documents provided in an accessible format or explained verbally
client agreement communication preferences and marketing consents

falsePositiveGuards: A standard contact preference is not a vulnerability adjustment; record it, but do not treat its presence as evidence that vulnerability was assessed.

sufficiency.ifBothAbsent: Note as a gap where vulnerability indicators are present.

queryGroups.requirement: Adjustments made to support client comprehension

queries.text: extra time given information repeated explained in simpler terms to aid understanding
follow up call to confirm the client understood the recommendation
adjustments made because of the client's circumstances health or capability
cooling off period client given time to consider before proceeding

falsePositiveGuards: Standard cancellation rights are a regulatory feature, not an adjustment made for this client.

sufficiency.ifEvidenceAbsent: Where indicators are present and no adjustment is recorded anywhere, that is the finding.

queryGroups.requirement: Vulnerability has a material impact on the recommendation (overlay)

queries.text: how the client's circumstances shaped the recommendation given their needs
risk of foreseeable harm to the client and how it has been mitigated
client age approaching retirement reliance on this money for essential income
queries.note: Structural vulnerability indicators that rarely appear under a vulnerability heading but bear directly on foreseeable harm.

queries.text: complexity of the recommendation relative to the client's ability to engage with it

falsePositiveGuards: Age alone is not vulnerability; combine it with reliance, health or capability indicators before concluding.
Where vulnerability is genuinely absent and that has been assessed and recorded, the overlay adds nothing — say so rather than manufacturing a concern.

sufficiency.ifBothAbsent: Where no vulnerability assessment exists anywhere in the case, record that as the finding — the overlay was never applied.
sufficiency.ifEvidenceAbsent: Where the report asserts no vulnerability but nothing in the file shows it was considered, treat the assertion as unsupported.

decision.noIssue: Vulnerability was assessed and recorded, any characteristics found are reflected in the report's description of support needs, communication and adjustments, and the recommendation accounts for them.
decision.potentialConcern: Indicators exist in the file that the report never reflects, support arrangements are asserted without evidence, or no vulnerability assessment appears anywhere in a case carrying clear drivers.
decision.notApplicable: Rarely applicable — this check is an overlay on all cases. Use N/A only where the case type places it out of scope entirely.
severityHints: Highest: a recorded vulnerability that materially affects suitability and is absent from the report's reasoning.
High: no vulnerability assessment anywhere in a case with clear FG21/1 drivers (health, life event, low resilience, low capability).
Moderate: support needs recorded in the file but not reflected in the report's communication or adjustments.
Low: communication preferences captured but not referenced in the report.
decision.overlayInstruction: After deciding this check, revisit the appropriateness limbs of CHK-002 to CHK-009 with any identified characteristics in scope. A recommendation that is appropriate for a resilient client may not be appropriate for this one.
